scale_cues: Stainless steel mixing bowl filling the frame (assumed ~25-30 cm rim diameter); carrot pile spans roughly a third of the bowl width; individual carrot shred size used as secondary cue.
assumptions: White chunks partially visible beneath the carrots are assumed to be diced cooked chicken breast; they could instead be cauliflower, feta, tofu or egg white.
Red rounded piece at the bottom edge of the pile is assumed to be a cherry tomato; one or two more may be hidden.
Hidden items under the carrot pile are estimated conservatively since only edges are visible.
No dressing, oil or sauce is visible, so none is included.
Bowl is assumed to be a standard medium mixing bowl; no cutlery or hand is present for a tighter scale reference.
